remarks: Welcome Home to Harbor House! - The luxury waterfront community nestled along the Long Island Sound in Stamford. As you enter, the open floor plan draws you to the stunning water-views. Wake up and savor your morning coffee overlooking the water. This beautiful retreat includes an open floor plan, updated wood-burning fireplace with granite trim plus a sliding glass door to your private patio, the perfect place for alfresco dining. The kitchen includes all new stainless-steel appliances, sub-zero refrigerator and a wine refrigerator. As you enter the primary suite, you are once again awed by the amazing water views. The updated primary bath includes double sinks, stall shower, jacuzzi tub and beautiful marble flooring. Renovated half bath, washer/dryer and assigned underground parking are all included. All this, plus, Heat and Hot Water are included in the common charges. Move right in and enjoy Waterfront Living at its finest!
